The '''''Xanter''-class frigate''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] designed by [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]] during an exploration boom which occurred approximately 500 [[Time/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] was designed from the ground up for exploration missions beyond known [[Realspace/Legends|space]] including such features as a hydroponic garden, a well-equipped galley, spacious quarters, and equipment for a variety of recreational activities. The class also carried three fully functional [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]] and a trio of ion engine systems to greatly decrease the chances of a ship being stranded by drive failure.<ref name="ETU" />

While all of these features reduced its armament to a level below that of most warships of the same size class, it still carried a variety of weapon systems for self-defense. The ''Xanter''-class also maintained hangar space for half a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]].<ref name="ETU" />

While the model was no longer in production during the build up to the Galactic Civil War, some remained in service in corporations or expeditions based in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="ETU" />
